@role: Canonical pattern-family to Kuhul glyph mapping above GGML lane descriptors.
@rule: XCFE controls legal phase/fold movement; Kuhul glyphs name semantic intent; native_glyph_engine executes bounded binary lanes; GGML/WebGPU provides backend tensor ops.

patterns.semantic_role: Load, store, carry, and move row-major or byte-level buffers.
examples: MathML matrix values become f32 LinALG buffers before WO_MATMUL.

patterns.semantic_role: Represent paths, links, semantic binds, adjacency, and intersection masks.
examples: Graph adjacency masks will later constrain attention and map routing.

patterns.semantic_role: Illuminate values, emit visualization state, and reuse chart templates.
examples: LinALG buffers may be emitted as chart-ready result metadata after Ch'en.

patterns.semantic_role: Synchronize, propagate, exchange, and stabilize tensor fields.
examples: Field transforms can use WO_MATMUL while future lanes add Laplacian and field_update.

patterns.semantic_role: Execute arithmetic, combination, guard, and comparison surfaces.
examples: ADD/SUB/MUL/DIV are scalar algebraic lanes; WO_MATMUL is the tensor algebraic lane.

patterns.semantic_role: Route, link, move, and apply reusable mapping patterns.
examples: Future gather/scatter/index lanes should bind here instead of overloading buffer movement.

patterns.semantic_role: Write/update tensors, multiply matrices, activate, and normalize.
examples: MathML matrixmultiply lowers to the tensor pattern and calls WO_MATMUL.

patterns.semantic_role: Normalize scores, route rotary position, execute attention, and emit context.
examples: SOFT_MAX/ROPE/FLASH_ATTN_EXT remain descriptor mappings until ABI lanes exist.

patterns.semantic_role: Gate execution lifecycle and preserve lawful movement through phases.
examples: MathML MATMUL records Pop -> Wo -> Sek -> Ch'en -> Xul in output JSON.
